branch_falsification_note: App GRF branch-level falsification status: FAILED check. The H-EW + A2 + calibrated-Z_i activation branch fails as an autonomous electroweak flow model (26.7% below sin^2 theta_W(M_Z) = 0.23122), and the pre-registered gauge-running check of App GRF section GRF.4.3 is FAILED. H-EW itself remains a Tier 3 hypothesis at an unspecified scale.

beta_coefficients_saturated.note: GCT saturated values match SM by Z_i calibration. The signs and activation schedule are model inputs; the equality is not an independent prediction.

alpha_s.tier: Tier 3 (bare 10 phi^2 calibrated handle) + Tier 3 (RGE running) — QLQCD-2 closure required (App QLA.7)
alpha_s.note: Bare value 10 phi^2 is a Tier 3 calibrated handle pending O.42 / QLQCD-2. Running uses Z_3-calibrated b_3 coefficient. The flow does not reproduce PDG alpha_s(M_Z) because the bare GUT-scale value (0.038) is too small to sustain 33.5 e-folds of asymptotic-free running (endpoint gap: err_GCT_vs_PDG_pct; Ch04 §4.5.5). QLQCD-2 closure (App QLA.7) is the canonical path; non-perturbative confinement corrections to the bare value are required.

uv_fixed_point_analysis.comment: GCT-native b_i(t) saturate at t = T_GUT once all 10 irreps of I_h are active. Beyond M_GUT the coefficients are constant. Within the Tier 3 activation ansatz this is distinct from Asymptotic Safety: the ansatz has a combinatorial UV cutoff set by the finite content of the icosahedral group, NOT a Weinberg-Reuter non-Gaussian fixed point. Whether the substrate supplies a UV completion is not settled by this ansatz.

closure_summary.alpha_s: Tier 3 (bare calibrated handle) / Tier 3 (running, QLQCD-2 pending)
closure_summary.overall_status: Calibrated/postdictive structural model. The I_h activation schedule and beta signs are Tier-3 model inputs; one Z_i calibration per coupling imposes the saturated SM coefficients. Imported A2=24 does not reproduce the measured alpha_2 or sin^2 endpoint, and the d=5 modes have zero running measure. alpha_s remains an open problem pending QLQCD-2 (App QLA.7).
